messages:
Jordan: Morning team  we need microcopy + inbound routing for the three page variants (Hosted API | Dedicated | Private) and the short launch-post pack. Can we lock this today?
Priya: I can run microcopy for Hosted API. Goal: concise, claim + one sentence proof, and a short CTA.
Devon: Ill do the Dedicated and Private bullets. Will include a tiny benchmark callout for Dedicated (sample QPS/p95) and a compliance line for Private.
Omar: Ill own the launch posts (twitter + linkedin) and the webinar RSVP form fields + UTM table. Quick ask: what form fields do you want surfaced for routing?
Tasha: Ops can wire the webhook rules once we have final field slugs. Prefer snake_case: deployment_choice, lead_type, company_size. Any other fields?
Jordan: Nice. Routing priority: 1) demo leads -> Sales immediate alert, 2) enterprise interest -> Sales AE + ops tag, 3) technical/dev questions -> DevX queue (daily digest), 4) webinar RSVPs -> Growth automation.
Priya: Draft Hosted headlines (short): A) "Hosted inference, production performance." B) "Fast API, predictable cost." C) "Start with free credits, scale transparently." Subheads: 1) "p50 latency ~100ms (example workload)" 2) "Curated open models + SDKs." CTAs: "Get started (free credits)", "View docs"
Devon: Dedicated bullets (micro): - "Reserved GPU pools" - "Throughput SLAs" - "Burst capacity" Add short benchmark blurb: "Example: 12x throughput on gpus-xx, p95 180ms on 2k tokens (see benchmarks)." Private bullets: - "VPC & on-prem options" - "KMS/HSM integrations" - "Audit logs & SOC2-ready"
Omar: Webinar promo draft: subject: "Running LLMs at production scale: cut cost, keep quality" Tweet: single-sentence hook + CTA to RSVP link with utm_source=launch_post. LinkedIn: 3 bullets on what attendees will learn + demo time. RSVP fields: `company_name`, `company_size`, `primary_use_case`, `deployment_choice (Hosted|Dedicated|Private)`, `lead_type (demo|enterprise|technical|webinar)`.
Tasha: Can implement with those slugs. Proposed routing rules (pseudo):``` 
if lead_type == "demo": route -> sales-demo-queue + slack:#sales-notifs immediate
elif lead_type == "enterprise": route -> sales-enterprise-queue + add_tag:enterprise_ops; slack:#sales-notifs
elif lead_type == "technical": route -> devx-ticket-queue; batch_digest:daily
elif lead_type == "webinar": route -> growth-rsvp-automation
if deployment_choice == "Private" and lead_type in ["demo","enterprise"]: add_tag:priority_private_ops
```
Tasha: Also will include payload example for webhook: `{"company_name":"...","lead_type":"demo",...}`. Need final sample send for staging test.
build-bot: Routing rules pushed to staging (job 9832) :white_check_mark: Logs: staging-webhook/9832
Jordan: Good. Quick copy tweak requests: Priya  add a short one-line example under Hosted showing a sample prompt -> sample response time (keeps claim concrete). Devon  ensure Dedicated benchmark phrasing is clearly labeled as "sample results" not guarantees. Omar  please add UTM variants table: twitter/linkedin/email.
Priya: Got it. Hosted alt lines: "Reply generation in ~100ms p50 for short-format prompts (sample)", short proof link to benchmarking.
Devon: Will label as "sample throughput" and link to benchmark page. Example numbers: "200 QPS on rtx-6000 equivalent; p95 220ms for 1k tokens (sample)".
Omar: Drafting UTM table now. Also webinar follow-up cadence proposal: Day0: confirmation + calendar link + 3-min preview video; Day2: short recap + checklist; Day7: qualified leads flagged to Sales for outreach.
Jordan: Action items + deadlines:
- Priya: finish Hosted microcopy + 2 alt CTAs (due 2:30pm)
- Devon: finalize Dedicated & Private bullets + benchmark snippet (due 2:30pm)
- Omar: publish launch-post drafts + UTM table + RSVP copy (due 3:30pm)
- Tasha: webhook rule draft + staging test payload (due 4:30pm)
- Jordan: collect final assets and push to /marketing-assets and tag #design for visuals (due 5pm)
Priya: Uploading doc to Google Drive and will paste link after edits.
Tasha: Will post webhook spec in this thread once staging test passes.
Omar: Scheduling the social posts for morning publish once copy is approved.
Jordan: One last style note  keep CTAs consistent across pages: primary = "Get started (free credits)"; secondary = "Contact sales" for Dedicated/Private.
Priya: Will match tone to other marketing pages  concise + engineering-forward.
Devon: Adding a 2-line FAQ snippet for Dedicated about scaling and support.
Tasha: Staging test queued. Will ping on success.
build-bot: Staging webhook test succeeded (9832) :rocket:
Jordan: Thanks everyone  ping here when complete and Ill assemble the launch bundle. React with :white_check_mark: when your item is done.
